_note: Unit prices in US dollars convert measured usage counts into a spend figure. Existing ledgers store then-derived costs that may have been rounded to six decimals; current rows retain full floating-point precision for hard-cap comparisons. Changing this file does not mutate or automatically re-price prior rows. Where the billed dimension was recorded, a separate read-only report can derive a corrected historical estimate while terminal ledgers remain immutable. Every provider entry names its source, verification date, and uncertainty.

anthropic._source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing and https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/model-ids-and-versions, verified 2026-09-04. Rates assume standard global inference: DAMM sets neither 2x fast mode nor the 1.1x US-only inference option. claude-haiku-4-5 is the provider's valid mutable alias; the current dated snapshot is claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. Unknown model identifiers fail closed.

openai._source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing and official gpt-5.6 Terra/Luna/Sol model pages, verified 2026-09-04. Output rates are exact list prices. Input rates conservatively reserve the documented 1.25x cache-write maximum because DAMM does not yet parse cache-write usage; long_context applies the provider's higher full-request tier above 272K input tokens. Sol's short-context rate is promotional through at least 2026-11-21.

gemini._source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing and official Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview / 2.5 Pro model pages, verified 2026-09-04. Each row applies the higher full-request rate when input exceeds 200K tokens. The unresolved mutable gemini-pro-latest alias was removed from resolution; unknown model identifiers fail closed. The exact production Gemini credential is Free tier and does not expose Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, so it is prohibited as a canary fallback.

perplexity._source: https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/getting-started/pricing and https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/sonar/models/sonar-pro, verified 2026-09-04. The helper pins low search context, whose Sonar Pro request fee is $6/1K.

exa._source: https://exa.ai/pricing?tab=api and https://exa.ai/docs/reference/contents-api-guide, verified 2026-09-04. Auto search is $7/1K through 10 results; text contents are included through 10. The helper rejects larger requests and does not request separately billed summaries.
exa._contents_source: https://exa.ai/docs/reference/pricing and https://exa.ai/docs/reference/get-contents, verified 2026-09-05. Contents costs $1/1K pages per content type. The helper requests exactly one URL, text only, with zero subpages and reserves the full $0.001 before dispatch. Search's included text remains separately priced above. Response costDollars is an estimate, not authoritative billing.

jina._source: https://jina.ai/reader/ and https://github.com/jina-ai/reader/blob/main/src/dto/crawler-options.ts, verified 2026-09-04. Reader bills returned output tokens. An authenticated read-only dashboard comparison verified that the exact Render production key belongs to the standard account package at $50/1B tokens ($0.05/MTok), with auto-recharge disabled and its prepaid balance unchanged during the audit. The public menu also lists $500/11B tokens (about $0.045/MTok premium), so $0.05/MTok remains the conservative current-account rate.
